en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4751 - Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, who said that

"There is no divorce except according to the Sunnah. Indeed, Abdullah ibn Umar divorced his wife three times in one sitting while she was menstruating.
The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) rejected his divorce and said: 'Whatever contradicts the Book of Allah (swt) must be referred back to the Book of Allah (swt).'"
